description: Investigate, diagnose, RCA, "why is X slow/broken/down", "what changed" for any production symptom. Triggers on a free-text symptom + service, a Datadog incident/monitor/dashboard/log URL, a Slack alert permalink, a Statsig gate/experiment URL, or a Mixpanel/Snowflake/Looker question. Read-only — never modifies a monitor, dashboard, flag, or experiment, and never triggers a rollback or restart (recommends; the human executes). Pins an explicit time window on every query, correlates >=2 independent signals before naming a root cause, and states confidence (low/med/high) with anchored evidence and <=15-word verbatim quotes. Produces a timeline + hypothesis + a lowest-blast-radius next action.
